question: Choose the antonym of 'prominent":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Obscure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"prominent"** means something that is important, famous, or easily noticeable; it stands out distinctly. (प्रमुख, प्रसिद्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a prominent figure in the field of medicine due to her groundbreaking research.
 
 
 
• **"Obscure" **refers to something that is not well-known, unclear, or hidden from view; it is the opposite of being prominent. (अस्पष्ट, अज्ञात)
 
 
• **Example: **The old manuscript was written by an obscure writer, whose name is lost to history.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the antonym of **'prominent' **is **'obscure'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Obscure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Renowned **(प्रसिद्ध): Known or talked about by many people; famous.

 
 
• **Example:** He is a renowned scientist who has won several awards for his research.
 
 
 
• **Eminent **(प्रख्यात): Famous and respected within a particular sphere or profession.
 
 
• **Example: **The conference was attended by several eminent scholars from around the world.
 
 
 
• **Conspicuous** (स्पष्ट): Standing out so as to be clearly visible or attracting attention.
 
 
• **Example:** Her bright red coat made her conspicuous in the crowd.
 
 

177:T74c,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
